info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contact Center Management API
info.description: The Contact Center Management API facilitates streamlined communication and operational oversight within banking contact centers. It provides essential resources for retrieving data related to customer interactions, performance metrics, and channel-specific operational details. This API is designed for financial institutions and customer service teams looking to enhance their support capabilities and improve response times. Utilize this endpoint for comprehensive insights on managing customer engagement and optimizing service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve channel-specific contact center management data.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed management information related to specific contact channels. Utilize this API to gain insights into channel operations and configurations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve channel-specific contact center management information. Ensure that the required parameters are included in the request to get the desired data.
